build_patcher_module: build a Patcher module with a given stride and padding mode for tensor patching
create_patched_tensor: create a Patched named tuple holding a patched tensor and its patch count
test_forward_patching: test the forward method to extract non-overlapping or overlapping patches from a 4D tensor
test_unpatch_reconstruction: test the unpatch method to reconstruct a 4D tensor from patched patches
review_pad_padding: review the _pad method that pads tensors for valid patch extraction with reflect mode
